Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics

Class TwoFluidUnsplitIntegrator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics.TwoFluidUnsplitIntegrator
public final class TwoFluidUnsplitIntegrator extends Object
Prepare an isothermal interval with bounded subdivision of rejected unsplit steps.

Every attempt uses a fresh transactional adapter and the last locally verified endpoint. Nonlinear failure bisects the attempted interval; failed iterates never enter accepted state or transport ledgers. All locally prepared substeps are discarded if the complete interval cannot be prepared. No pipe clock, stream or diagnostic is committed. The caller owns any subsequent atomic commit and transport of components with the accepted face ledger.

Subdivision controls nonlinear convergence, not temporal truncation error. It neither smooths closure transitions nor certifies their physical validity. The solver's settings and production transient defaults remain unchanged.

  • Method Details

    • setPressureInterpolationEnabled

      public void setPressureInterpolationEnabled(boolean enabled)
      Select experimental transient pressure interpolation inside each trial's conservative face fluxes.

      The mobility uses the selected temporal weight times each attempted step, including retries. It vanishes for linear pressure profiles and couples the alternating cell-pressure mode. This is not a retained-face-history scheme or a general hydrostatic well-balancing treatment.

      Parameters:
      enabled - true to include the interpolation defect; default false

    • prepareInterval

      public TwoFluidUnsplitIntegrator.PreparedInterval prepareInterval(TwoFluidSection[] acceptedSections, double spatialStep, double duration, double startTime, double outletPressure, boolean outletPressureFixed, double relativeTolerance)
      Verify the complete requested interval before exposing a candidate for commit.
      Parameters:
      acceptedSections - immutable-to-this-call accepted section templates
      spatialStep - representative cell size in m; actual cell lengths define inventories
      duration - requested interval duration in s; its endpoint is the representable sum startTime + duration
      startTime - accepted start time in s
      outletPressure - external outlet-face pressure in Pa
      outletPressureFixed - whether that outlet-face pressure is prescribed
      relativeTolerance - independent endpoint and conservative residual verification tolerance
      Returns:
      immutable prepared interval with every accepted time-level transport ledger
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid time, geometry, state or density inputs
      IllegalStateException - for an unsupported operator or failed independent endpoint verification
      TwoFluidUnsplitIntegrator.IntervalPreparationException - if nonlinear retries, substeps or representable time are exhausted

    • prepareInterval

      public TwoFluidUnsplitIntegrator.PreparedInterval prepareInterval(TwoFluidSection[] acceptedSections, double spatialStep, double duration, double startTime, double outletPressure, boolean outletPressureFixed, double relativeTolerance, double maximumTimeStep)
      Prepare a complete interval with an independent upper bound on the nominal nonlinear time step.

      The interval is divided into equal nominal steps no larger than the requested bound, subject to representable clock rounding. Nonlinear rejection may subdivide them further. The complete-interval transaction and cumulative conservation gates are identical to prepareInterval(TwoFluidSection[], double, double, double, double, boolean, double). This controls nominal step size, not temporal truncation error.

      Parameters:
      acceptedSections - accepted section templates
      spatialStep - representative cell size in m
      duration - requested complete interval in s
      startTime - accepted start time in s
      outletPressure - external outlet pressure in Pa
      outletPressureFixed - whether that pressure is prescribed
      relativeTolerance - independent endpoint and complete-interval conservation tolerance
      maximumTimeStep - positive finite nominal step bound in s
      Returns:
      immutable complete interval with exact accepted-substep ledgers
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid inputs or a nominal step count above the configured budget
      IllegalStateException - for unsupported configurations, failed verification or exhausted nonlinear retries
